title: Gethsemane: beginning to be sorrowful
english: Taking [[Peter and the two sons of Zebedee >> Bible:Matthew 26:37]], he [[began to be sorrowful and troubled >> Bible:Matthew 26:37]]. These same disciples he had taken onto the mountain when he was to be transfigured. He began to be sorrowful — there is a great difference between being sorrowful and beginning to be sorrowful. [[Tempted in every way as we are, yet without sin >> Bible:Hebrews 4:15]], he was not simply swallowed by the passion’s sadness but, according to human nature, began.
translator_notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Let this cup pass — true flesh, true will
english: [[Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me; yet not as I will, but as you will >> Bible:Matthew 26:39]]. Taking human flesh’s nature he fulfilled all its properties so he would not be thought to have flesh only in appearance but in truth. It belongs to every faithful human first not to want to suffer, especially unto death; yet if God wills, to consent even against one’s own will. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Series rem Gethsemane from PG 13 Latin.
